# Trigger catalogue — sprezzature-audio

**Generated by `scripts/build_triggers.py`. Do not hand-edit.** A test asserts this file equals the generated output, so a phrase added here and nowhere else fails CI.

Drafts WebVTT / SRT captions via whisper.cpp, adds speaker diarization (NeMo Sortformer), speaker ID (TitaNet or transcript-based rule + local Ollama), and speaker-labelled VTT — and reads written text aloud through Kokoro, OpenVoice or Chatterbox, timed track included.

## When this skill is the answer

**You are holding:** Recorded speech somebody needs as text, a question about that text — or written text somebody needs as speech.

A phrase list cannot generalise — the ways to ask are unbounded, and a user almost never names the tool. What is bounded is the kind of thing in front of them. Match that first; the phrases below confirm a match, they do not make one.

Said without naming a tool: "what did they say in this meeting", "who spoke when", "subtitles", "read this aloud", « de quoi ils parlent dans cet enregistrement »

## When it is not

Not this one when: the job is to wire a narration into a page — player, read-along highlighting, the site (sprezzature-publish, which calls this one for the voice) — or the words describe an image (sprezzature-accessibility). The catalogue is in `references/triggers.md`.
